questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with bit A pointing to the LEFT with the solved board configuration, describe the path of the blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto bit at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (2, 1), then ramp_left at (3, 2), then ramp_right at (2, 3), then ramp_left at (3, 4), then ramp_right at (2, 5), then ramp_right at (3, 6), then ramp_right at (4, 7), then bit at (5, 8), then ramp_left at (6, 9), then crossover at (5, 10), and is caught at the left exit.

questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with bit A pointing to the RIGHT with the solved board configuration, describe the path of the balls.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto bit at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (2, 1), then ramp_left at (3, 2), then ramp_right at (2, 3), then ramp_left at (3, 4), then ramp_right at (2, 5), then ramp_right at (3, 6), then ramp_right at (4, 7), then bit at (5, 8), then ramp_left at (6, 9), then crossover at (5, 10), and is caught at the left exit.

questions.question: How does this puzzle differ from Challenge 14, and what component makes the difference?
questions.answer: 2 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits left, intercepted. 1 exit left, 0 exit right, 1 is intercepted.
